notes: Fixed: "the host is unreachable, schema only until the VPN is up" while the VPN was up and SSMS was connected to the same server. The check asked DNS for IPv4 and IPv6 together, and behind the VPN's split DNS that question comes back empty for a host that has no IPv6 address — so a live server was reported as down, and any run started then lost its row data for its whole length. It now retries IPv4-only and then straight at the DNS servers before it believes it. Measured against the real server: unreachable 5 times out of 5 before, reachable 5 out of 5 after.
The same check is what decides "Azure DevOps cannot be reached", so that banner could be wrong for the same reason. It is fixed too.
Carries 2.15.0: Minimize on any gate card, the DBA's two SQL standards built in and shipped with the app, and no more comments written into the code it changes.
And 2.14.0: the 2.13.0 start-screen fix, and your real plan usage (the /usage figure) in the strip.
